scoring_justification: Agent submits only final computed values; recompute from raw DFT total energies is infeasible without those intermediates. Compare to paper-reported values with tolerances.

outputs.description: Formation energies of the dominant defects at the charge-neutrality Fermi level under Pb-rich and Br-rich conditions, computed from HSE+SOC total energies and Freysoldt correction.
Thermodynamic charge-state transition levels for the deep-level defects Br interstitial, H interstitial, and H on Br site, referenced to the valence band maximum.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the submitted values to a hidden reference set (paper-reported results) with tolerances and checks internal consistency: transition levels must be consistent with the submitted formation energies at E_F=0 within a tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for formation energies and transition levels
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values extracted from main text and figures (e.g., Pb‑rich E_F0=1.66 eV, Br-rich E_F0=0.37 eV, defect formation energies and transition levels from Fig. 1 & 2 and surrounding discussion).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the published paper (J. Mater. Chem. A, 2021, 9, ...).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are verbatim from the paper; no alteration.
